name: What are the typical financial commitments and payment structures for a pre-construction condo?

mainEntity.name: What are the typical financial commitments and payment structures for a pre-construction condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buying a pre-construction condo typically involves a series of deposit payments to the developer spread out over the construction period, rather than a single down payment at contract signing. These deposits can range from 10% to 50% of the purchase price, paid in installments. A practical tradeoff to consider is tying up capital over a longer period, but this also allows buyers to spread out their financial commitment before the final closing, which can be beneficial when planning your budget.
